probes.diagnosis: DISCOVERY-EXHAUSTION (corrected per M9 receipts: 20/20 kind=sitemap, 18x200 + 404 + 301, seqs 718-737, zero page-kind, proof never engaged). Sitemap-miss x2 forced listing-fallback harvesting: 18 HTML listing pages yielded 209 candidates, 145 queued as leads — but harvest fetches consumed the entire 20-attempt cap before any page fetch, so the 145 queued leads were never fetched and the JSON-LD proof/thin gates (candidateFromPageHtml :758-798, singleProductIdentity :338-369) never ran on this domain. Lesson: fallback discovery without a reserved page budget burns caps — cap discovery harvest separately or gate queue-before-harvest. The prior draft's proof-failure claim for M9 was wrong and is withdrawn.
